meta.title: Abdul Azeem — Sr. Software Engineer
meta.description: Fullstack Software Engineer based in Germany. TypeScript, React, Python, GCP, AI integrations.

aboutDone: 7+ years shipping production software across startups, scale-ups, and larger organisations
Built B2B platforms, auth systems, payment integrations, e-commerce, and OTT streaming products
Worked across the full stack — React, React Native, TypeScript, Django, Go, GraphQL, PostgreSQL
Not limited to any fixed set of technologies — I pick whatever solves the problem best
sections.aboutCanLabel: What I bring to the table
aboutCan: End-to-end product delivery: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
Agentic software engineering — configuring autonomous AI systems with validation loops, strict constraints, and context to build, test, and maintain code with minimal manual intervention
Modern software practices: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven systems, and efficient feedback loops
Adaptable to new domains — digitalisation, business applications, hybrid AI+software systems, automation
howIWorkItems: Define the problem and acceptance criteria before writing any code
Use AI agents with strict constraints, validation loops, and architecture guardrails — not conversational prompting
Ship incrementally: working software first, then iterate with automated feedback
Every feature ships with tests, type safety, and CI/CD — no exceptions
Scale the process to the project: lightweight for small builds, full governance for platforms
